title: BioEmu2: Scalable Emulation of Biomolecular Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.27924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite major advances in structure prediction, modelling the motions and interactions that drive biomolecular function at scale remains a central challenge. We introduce BioEmu2, a generative model for atomically resolved biomolecular structures combining static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling and time evolution, that samples orders of magnitude faster than molecular dynamics (MD). Trained on experimental and synthetic structures and extensive MD data, it supports multi-component systems containing proteins, nucleic acids, modified residues, ligands and ions. Structure-prediction accuracy is comparable to top open-weight biomolecular folding models, and a context parallel mode enables prediction of megadalton complexes. Equilibrium distributions approximate MD references with free-energy errors near 1 kcal/mol across tested proteins and complexes. translated_title: BioEmu2：可扩展的生物分子动力学模拟
translated_abstract: 尽管结构预测已取得重大进展，但在大规模尺度上模拟驱动生物分子功能的运动与相互作用仍然是一项核心挑战。我们提出了BioEmu2，一个面向原子级分辨率生物分子结构的生成模型，它将静态结构预测、平衡态采样与时间演化结合在一起，其采样速度比分子动力学（MD）快数个数量级。该模型在实验结构、合成结构以及大量MD数据上训练，支持包含蛋白质、核酸、修饰残基、配体和离子的多组分体系。其结构预测精度可与顶尖的开源权重生物分子折叠模型相媲美，且上下文并行模式使其能够预测兆道尔顿规模的复合物。其平衡态分布可逼近MD参考结果，在所测试的蛋白质和复合物上自由能误差接近1 kcal/mol。时间传播功能可预测长时间尺度的动力学轨迹以及……的动力学（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: BioEmu2是一个融合静态结构预测、平衡态采样与时间演化的原子级生物分子动力学生成模型，采样速度比分子动力学快数个数量级，可支持兆道尔顿级多组分复合物预测，平衡分布自由能误差接近1 kcal/mol，并能预测长时程动力学轨迹。
en_tdlr: BioEmu2 is a generative model that unifies static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling, and time evolution of atomically resolved biomolecular structures, sampling orders of magnitude faster than MD while supporting megadalton multi-component complexes with ~1 kcal/mol free-energy accuracy and long-timescale trajectory prediction.
